title: Teen Karen Turns Welfare Check Into DUI Arrest Meltdown
description:
A routine welfare check in Barnegat, New Jersey escalated after police watched 18-year-old Stephanie Starr drive up to the scene while intoxicated. Officers say Starr was belligerent and refused field sobriety and breath testing, leading to a struggle and her arrest. Her boyfriend Anthony Judice and his brother Rocco Giannotti were initially evasive as police tried to piece together what happened. Investigators later found alcohol in Starr’s car, and she was charged with DWI, refusal, reckless and careless driving, and open container. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
